role: The user-facing slash commands the plugin installs. Files whose name begins with _ are shared prose fragments included by the others, not commands.

invariants.statement: Every command file starts with a YAML frontmatter fence on line 1.
invariants.why: The loader reads the command's metadata out of the frontmatter. A file with prose on line 1 loads as a command with no metadata rather than as an error, so the command silently appears unnamed and undescribed instead of failing to install.

invariants.statement: Every command file declares a description in its frontmatter.
invariants.why: The description is the only text a user sees when choosing between commands. Without it the command is listed as a bare name, and the user picks by guessing.

invariants.statement: No command file may contain an absolute /home/<user> path; the placeholder form /home/<your-user> is the way to show one.
invariants.why: These files ship to users. An author's own home path in a command reads to the user as an instruction and sends them to a directory that does not exist on their machine.

counterexample.content:
---
description: run phase 1
---

Run it in /home/someuser/AI_IC_design/proj.
